unsupported.why: record:brief does not say this. The only refusal reason it gives is a G1 judge finding. The 'G2' label and the three file names appear in the brief only inside the quoted attempt-3 sentence, and that sentence was the one refused as unsupported, so repeating it does not ground it. The judge note in the brief says the earlier reason was that 'the agent never read that file in this session'. That is one file, unnamed, and no gate is given. Nothing in the brief says that claims cited those three files or that a check reported all three as unread. The list of files read for this evaluation actually shows ci.mjs, package.json and CLAUDE.md as read.

improvements: Cut the revision note down to what record:brief actually shows: the previous result was refused because the agent never read a file it cited, and this version cites no repository file directly. Don't name a gate or specific files unless the brief states them.

Either cite the code read (tool:repo shows only view helpers) for 'styles', or point to CA-3 and CQ-FE-1 so the fact and the open question don't overlap.

FC-2 cites feat.prd (AC-19, NFR-10), but the output could make clearer that the exact heading strings come from feat.trd IF-7.2 and feat.design B4.2. feat.prd only supports the terminology rule.
notes: Apart from the revision note, the component list is grounded.
